text:
Eli: Heads-up: Atlas Appliances + Capella SI want a marketplace-friendly retainer SKU that wires to their HW bundle. Sales wants simple listing so partners can self-serve. Compliance: GovCloud / KMS implications. Thoughts?

Nina: We should avoid listing anything that requires on-prem key custody. If KMS/HSM is required, force private contract. Marketplace for everything else.

Omar: Agreed. Also flag: billing cadence. The SI prefers monthly retainer draws that net against consumption quarterly. Marketplace feeds into annual invoice flows, so reconcile mismatch.

Priya: Proposal: publish a "virtual retainer" marketplace SKU that represents 12 months but supports monthly draw reconciliation on our side. At renewal we reconcile and issue credits or top-ups. Ops overhead but preserves marketplace discoverability.

Theo: How do we handle partner co-sell discounts? Need to surface the SI margin in the checkout flow or via promo codes. Marketplace UI is limited. Maybe maintain partner discount as an off-invoice credit handled in Partner Portal.

Eli: fallback conditions? If marketplace enrollment is blocked (quota or policy), auto-create a private PO and notify the seller/partner with migration instructions. Need a 48h warning window before failover.

Nina: telemetry hook suggestion: emit "commit_pressure" when usage >=75% of committed band for 45 consecutive days AND trending up. That should generate a sales+partner_ops task.

Omar: renewal incentive: first renewal conversion to a standard commit = 10% discount ladder if they increase commit by >=15%. We should document the tiers.

Priya: Legal: ensure virtual SKU terms allow transition to private terms on onboarding or if escrow/KMS required. Also call out data residency exceptions for GovCloud.

PartnersBot: NOTE: Listing approvals for hardware-bundled SKUs require security review. See ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PRT-5033

Eli: timeline: if we want co-announce with Atlas/Capella, marketing needs 3 weeks for joint assets + partner signoff. That means SKU must be approved 4 weeks before publish.

Theo: Partner enablement: create a 20-min playbook + one-pager on how the virtual SKU flows to partner commissions. We can reuse existing partner portal hooks.

Nina: operational detail: mapping table in Partner Portal should link marketplace_sku -> internal_contract_template_id -> partner_split_code. We'll need a small migration script.

Omar: ops ask: how to reconcile monthly draws vs tokenized usage if the customer bursts heavily one month? Do we apply overage billing or consume from escrowed retainer?

Priya: policy: retainer draw covers up to X tokens/month; overage billed at marketplace list rates unless customer upgrades the band mid-term. We should include an upgrade path in the Console UI.

Eli: action items: Priya -> Legal clause draft (due Fri). Nina -> telemetry alert spec + sample payload (due Tue). Theo -> partner enablement deck + one-pager (due Wed). Omar -> migration script outline for mapping table (due Thu). Eli -> coordinate listing approval and announce timeline (will open PR).

PartnersBot: PR created: https://redwood.internal/prs/8012  partners/virtual-retainer-listing (Eli).
